_provenance: CONFIRMED calibration (validation brief 2026-08-09). SEED targets: Correlation Ventures US venture financing outcomes 2004-2013, n=21,640 (Seth Levine 2014 / Forbes-Booth 2014): <1x 64.8%, 1-5x 25.3%, 5-10x 5.9%, 10-20x 2.5%, 20-50x 1.1%, >50x 0.4% — the provisional targets matched the published figures exactly, no refit needed. CONVENTION: this model's 'alpha' is the SURVIVAL exponent P(>x) ~ x^-alpha; the CSN density exponent = alpha+1. Fitted seed alpha REFIT 2026-08-20 to 1.45 => CSN 2.45, essentially ON the AngelList/Othman CSN MLE 2.42 (winners, xmin=1) and the CV-bucket-implied ~2.44 (was 1.70 => CSN 2.70, above the published range); Moonfire production omega 2.05. Literature range (brief): seed CSN 2.0-2.7 => survival 1.0-1.7; Series B CSN 2.5-3.0 => survival 1.5-2.0. SERIES_B targets constructed per brief: loss mass 0.40 (CV dollar-basis 37% <1x, 2021 update; Carta A->B graduation 9-25%), conditional body CV-shaped, tail survival alpha 1.75 (CSN 2.75, mid of published B range). Series B mid-buckets are CONSTRUCTED (no published 6-bucket B histogram exists) and are so labeled. Cross-checks: Cochrane 2005 corrected lognormal (log mean 15%/yr, log sd 89%/yr); Korteweg-Sorensen 2010 (monthly idio sigma 41%). Fee map: net=1+0.8(g-1), matches audited EV trees. | GATE CHANGE 2026-08-20: added a RELATIVE bucket-fit gate (10%) alongside the absolute one - the absolute 0.015 tolerance is structurally blind to buckets whose target is 0.004 and was concealing a 39% underfit of the seed >50x bucket. Also rewrote the tree-reconciliation gate to compare the curve CAPPED at the tree's top branch (20x) rather than uncapped, tightening tolerance 0.35 -> 0.10, and added an explicit uncapped-tail-premium disclosure gate. DIRECTION-OF-BIAS DISCLOSURE: the refit raises every logged deal's uncapped EV (+0.04 to +0.18) and capped EV (+0.025 to +0.069). No verdict flips and no ordering changes.

seed._note: Targets = published CV 2004-2013 pooled figures verbatim (confirmed 2026-08-09). REFIT 2026-08-20: original params (mu -0.70, sigma 1.80, x_tail 12, alpha 1.70) passed the ABSOLUTE gate but underfit the 5-10x / 20-50x / >50x buckets by 10.6% / 17.0% / 39.3% RELATIVE - the absolute tolerance 0.015 is structurally blind to buckets whose target is 0.004. Refit minimizes MAX RELATIVE error: 3.1% worst bucket, down from 39.3%. Consequences: implied mean 2.005x -> 2.328x, P(>=10x) 3.68% -> 4.05%. Side benefit - the fitted survival alpha moves 1.70 -> 1.45, i.e. CSN density exponent 2.70 -> 2.45, which lands essentially ON the AngelList/Othman MLE of 2.42 and the CV-bucket-implied ~2.44 cited in _provenance, instead of sitting above the published range. Better fit AND better literature agreement.

series_b._note: CONSTRUCTED stage-conditional anchor (loss mass 0.40 cited to CV-dollars/Carta; tail survival alpha 1.75 = CSN 2.75 per published B-round range; mid-buckets emerge from fit, not from a published histogram — labeled as such on any display). VALIDATED AGAINST MEASUREMENT 2026-08-15: PitchBook Part IV (US, n=31,642 first rounds 2009-2018) publishes a measured Series C+ MOIC histogram 50/41/6/2/1/0 across these exact buckets - close to this constructed shape; loss-mass band documented as 0.40 (CV-dollars floor) to 0.50 (PB C+ count ceiling); fitted 0.417 sits at the optimistic end, gate-tested within band. Deal verdicts insensitive to anchor choice (tilt pins logged forecasts; sensitivity ~0.05pp on P(net>=20x)). Study: validation/pitchbook-series-study-2026-08-15.md.
